data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme tracking Nifty Bank Index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to replicate the Nifty Bank Index by investing in securities of the Nifty Bank Index in the same proportion / weightage with an aim to provide returns before expenses that track the total return of Nifty Bank Index, subject to tracking errors. However, there is no assurance or guarantee that the objectives of the scheme will be realized and the scheme does not assure or guarantee any returns.
data.asset_allocation: Securities belonging to the Nifty Bank Index (including stock and index derivatives) - 95% - 100% Debt & Money Market instruments & Mutual Fund- 0%- 5%
data.exit_load: 0.25% - if redeemed on or before 15 days from the allotment date. • Nil – if redeemed after 15 days from the allotment date.
